_README: Archetype mean vectors for the trait sampler (briefing section 5).
DATA, NOT CODE. Editable without a rebuild: the sampler reads this file through
archetypes.ts and nothing here is compiled. Values are z-scores on a population
with mean 0 and standard deviation 1, so +1.4 is 'high' and -1.4 is 'low'.
MEANS ARE NAMED, NOT POSITIONAL. Author each trait by name. A bare array of six
decimals is the one place an index-order mistake could enter this component by
hand, and it would produce plausible-looking output that is wrong in a way no
eye would catch.
'sketch' is the briefing section 5 latent sketch the vector was authored against.
Keep it beside the numbers: it is the only record of what they were aiming at.
'defining' lists the traits the sketch actually pins. It is load-bearing, not
documentation: the separation constraint (briefing section 4.3) compares two
archetypes on the union of their defining traits, and traits the sketch leaves
free are deliberately excluded so a pair cannot pass on the strength of numbers
nobody chose. quietLurker is 'low E, moderate elsewhere', so extraversion is the
only thing that defines it.
AFTER EDITING, RUN 'npm run verify:traits'. Every pair of archetypes must sit at
least archetypeSeparation apart on the union of their defining traits, and the
loader enforces it on startup. Two archetypes closer than that are one archetype
with two names.
'version' NAMES THIS SET. Quality bounds and calibration surfaces are properties of a
specific archetype set, not of the generator in the abstract: a legitimate improvement
here moves them. Any bound written against these numbers must name this version.
POSITIONS COME FROM A JOINT SOLVE, not from hand-placement. The fifteen
between-archetype correlations are coupled across the points, so fixing one pair moves
the others; sequential patching does not converge. Run 'npm run solve:archetypes' after
any edit, read the proposal as descriptions of people, and only then accept it.

archetypes.label: Ingratiator
archetypes.sketch: high C, high E, high A, low H; organised, warm, socially skilled, and self-serving with it
archetypes.note: AUTHORED, NOT SKETCHED IN THE BRIEFING, and product-driven rather than read off any data. It fills a quadrant the original eight left empty: every agreeable archetype in that set was also honest, so Honesty-Humility carried no variation independent of Agreeableness (r = 0.935 across the eight means) and the set could not express the good-faith versus manipulative distinction the sixth dimension exists to make. In a room this is the member who is pleasant to everyone and is working it. When reference data lands, whether real populations contain a type resembling this becomes an answerable question and the answer may revise it. POSITION FROM THE JOINT SOLVE (npm run solve:archetypes), not hand-placed: the fifteen between-archetype correlations are coupled across the eleven points and cannot be satisfied one pair at a time. The label was checked against the solved position afterwards, not the other way round.

archetypes.label: Principled contrarian
archetypes.sketch: low A, high H, low C; blunt and argumentative, sincere and fair, and disorganised with it
archetypes.note: AUTHORED, NOT SKETCHED IN THE BRIEFING, and product-driven. The opposite unoccupied quadrant to ingratiator: disagreeable but straight. terseExpert gestured at this (A -0.05, H 0.40) and gestured weakly. Together the two make Honesty-Humility carry information Agreeableness does not, which is what the sixth dimension was added for. archetypes.label: Anxious and scrupulous
archetypes.sketch: high N, high H; the worrier who is meticulously fair
archetypes.note: AUTHORED, NOT SKETCHED IN THE BRIEFING, and product-driven. Added for COVERAGE rather than to reach a number: the joint solve satisfied the neuroticism/honesty correlation target by rebalancing the other archetypes and left this region empty, so the correlation was repaired while the population gap remained. Frets about doing the right thing, apologises more than necessary, entirely trustworthy. Its absence encoded the proposition that anxious people are less honest, which nothing supports and the model explicitly denies. archetypes.note: The production-facing archetype for support avatars. Its moderate E and moderate O are what hold it apart from roleModel, which is high on both.
